added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: Q12's lifting change (a saturating BM25 term) is named but never measured by nDCG@10, while §11's done_when requires the lifting change measured over the 18 questions; none of the three measured variants raises Q12 into top 30 because the reserved-slot variant reserves only 20 leaders and shtrd.f's chunk sits at facility vector rank 49.

follow-on: the Q14/Q18 "Tool rank" figures (1734/2000 and 1330/2000) come from a k=2000 call and contradict the node's own census fragment (which reports the same pages at ranks 181 and 163) and stages.json (181 and 164 at k=200), so the column does not name the rank the tool gives the answer at any depth it is actually called with.

item_verdicts.diff: one file against the base, +175 lines, docs-only — no code change and no graph write, as §11 requires.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the burying stage per answer plus a lifting change measured over the 18 §9 questions by nDCG@10; final_metrics.py measures three changes (bounded fusion, RRF, reserved slots) and none of them lifts Q12, whose named remedy is asserted but unmeasured.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to trace how _search_code/_search_docs build and score for the four §11 answers; docs/evidence/fragments/discovery-judgments-through-jev/retrieval-scoring-probe.html:1-60 does exactly that, naming for each of Q05/Q12/Q14/Q18 the vector index and k, the facility pre-filter, the hybrid terms and the final sort.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest reads status complete and names the nDCG comparison in final_metrics.py against labels.json, with the raw per-query JSON and stage logs recorded beside it.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are the node report dir, docs/evidence/fragments/discovery-judgments-through-jev/retrieval-scoring-probe.html, and docs/figures/discovery-judgments-through-jev/retrieval-scoring-probe; the single landed file is inside them and the figures path is unused.

justifications.durability: the node ships no test; a docs-only evidence fragment cannot carry one, so its only guard is the re-runnable raw JSON and scripts under the report dir, and no assertion fails if the numbers drift.
justifications.evidence: the gate at final_metrics.py:50-101 measures the nDCG@10 changes and its per-query result is recorded in final_metrics_rrf.json, but the reviewed run ships two divergent baselines (fusion_rrf.json variant_scores baseline 0.2763 vs final_metrics_rrf.json current 0.4204) and the docs tool rank in docs/evidence/fragments/discovery-judgments-through-jev/retrieval-scoring-probe.html:77 is depth-dependent.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/fragments/discovery-judgments-through-jev/retrieval-scoring-probe.html:1-8 follows the sibling fragment's idiom (section[data-reckon=evidence], id-per-block, caption) and introduces no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/discovery-judgments-through-jev/retrieval-scoring-probe.html:40-100 traces both tools' candidate stages and reproduces the raw cosine of each answer from its stored embedding (0.438/0.560/0.713/0.764 in stages.json), so the burying stage is named from measurement, not inference.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no code, but the report scripts duplicate a capability the repository already owns — the tool's merge formula is re-implemented in fusion_eval.py:40-79 and nDCG is implemented twice (fusion_eval.py:32 and final_metrics.py:30).
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff adds exactly docs/evidence/fragments/discovery-judgments-through-jev/retrieval-scoring-probe.html and nothing else, inside the declared write paths.
